limitations: Public examples are not official hidden inputs.
The real model and official Replay were not run.
Time-bounded search varies with CPU scheduling.
Only single-chunk moves with immediate strict improvement are explored.
Shared bottlenecks or equal-cost intermediate moves can prevent further local improvement.
